mintAuthority.summary: USBD has one reviewed canonical native Liquity-v1-fork CDP issuance deployment on Ethereum. Hemi, Plume, Sonic, BSC, and Nibiru expose the same DebtToken/OFT bytecode and documented local CDP stacks, but their destination balances are not reconciled at fixed observations as independent native liabilities rather than LayerZero OFT supply, so those routes remain in Bridge Risk. Ethereum BorrowerOperations is collateral/debt-ceiling bounded, while the shared BimaCore owner EOA can mint directly without limit, install new mint adapters or TroveManagers, and raise ceilings. LayerZero OFT peer/delegate and destination delivery administration is separately reviewed under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: BIMA BorrowerOperations (Liquity-v1 fork)
controls.capDescription: Mint gated by per-collateral debt ceilings and a 150% minimum collateral ratio enforced by the TroveManager/Factory.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770562, the local DebtToken pointed to this BorrowerOperations contract; the local BorrowerOperations, Factory, and BimaCore owner paths remained linked to the separately modeled EOA. It is the user-facing CDP minter bounded by collateral checks and per-market maxSystemDebt and cannot raise its own ceilings.

controls.label: BimaCore governance / parameter admin
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770562, BimaCore.owner()/guardian(), Factory.owner()/guardian(), and BorrowerOperations.owner() resolved to this code-empty EOA; the local DebtToken remained linked to the local Factory and BorrowerOperations and its lendingVaultAdapterAddress remained zero. Verified source gives this owner unbounded authorizedMint, adapter replacement, new TroveManager authorization, and maxSystemDebt raise paths.
controls.capDescription: Unbounded: DebtToken.authorizedMint() has no cap, and this EOA can also raise each collateral maxSystemDebt via TroveManager.setParameters().

review.evidence: Fixed-block observations on 2026-08-16 confirmed Ethereum's local native CDP mint path: its DebtToken points to the local BorrowerOperations/Factory stack, the local BimaCore owner/guardian is the code-empty EOA 0xaca5d659364636284041b8d3acad8a57f6e7b8a5, and the direct deployment has a zero EIP-1967 implementation slot. Verified Bima source permits that shared owner to call uncapped authorizedMint, install a mint-capable adapter, authorize new TroveManagers, and raise per-market maxSystemDebt. The official Bima registry and fixed-block reads also confirm local BorrowerOperations/Factory/DebtToken pointers and documented collateral markets on Hemi, Plume, Sonic, BSC, and Nibiru, but the identical regular OFT can mint destination balances through authenticated LayerZero delivery. No primary source in this review provides a per-chain reserve/liability reconciliation separating each destination balance from OFT supply: Hemi's local Trove debt is not a full supply reconciliation, Plume and Sonic had nonzero token supply with zero local Trove debt at the fixed observations, and current BSC/Nibiru checks were zero supply and zero local debt. Under the conservative mint/bridge boundary, only the Ethereum deployment is admitted to Mint Authority. The separate DebtToken owner/delegate EOA 0xe3fbba95bb35be804696624dd1e9344a86e3cbc4 controls LayerZero OFT peers and application/delegate configuration and is authored only under Bridge Risk. Canonical native mint semantics remain unbounded, reconciliation is not applicable, no Safe modules or guards apply, and no prudential supervisor was identified.
